record.original_question: Among all connected graphs with a fixed number of vertices, is the adjacency spectral gap lambda_1(G) - lambda_2(G) minimized by some double kite graph?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 18 (Stanić [139]). The spectral gap is minimized for some double kite graph over all connected graphs with given number of vertices.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For integers $r \geq 2$ and $s \geq 0$, the double kite graph $DK(r,s)$ is the graph obtained by taking two disjoint copies of the complete graph $K_r$, choosing one vertex from each copy, and joining these two chosen vertices by a path of length $s+1$ (so $DK(r,s)$ has $2r+s$ vertices). For a finite simple graph $G$, let $\lambda_1(G) \geq \lambda_2(G) \geq \cdots$ denote the eigenvalues of its adjacency matrix, and define the (adjacency) spectral gap of $G$ to be $\lambda_1(G) - \lambda_2(G)$.

Prove or disprove: for every integer $n \geq 2$, the minimum of $\lambda_1(G) - \lambda_2(G)$ over all connected graphs $G$ on $n$ vertices is attained by some double kite graph $DK(r,s)$ with $2r+s = n$.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture, due to Stanić, asserts that the minimum spectral gap among connected graphs on n vertices is achieved by a double kite graph. It has been verified computationally for connected graphs on up to about 10 vertices, with metaheuristic evidence extending up to 15 vertices, but no general proof or counterexample is known. It remains an open problem in spectral graph theory.

status_evidence.title: Graphs with small spectral gap (Stanić)
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture that connected graphs with given number of vertices and minimum spectral gap are double kite graphs; verified for small n by computation.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture is supported by computational evidence but remains unresolved in general.

status_evidence.title: Trees with small spectral gap, Ars Mathematica Contemporanea
status_evidence.snippet: References Stanić's double kite conjecture as an open question with partial evidence.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture is treated as open in follow-up literature.
